# Vendored browser dependencies

- Bootstrap 5.3.8: https://getbootstrap.com/ (MIT), CSS and bundled JavaScript.
- Chart.js 4.5.1: https://www.chartjs.org/ (MIT), UMD distribution.

Downloaded from versioned npm packages through cdn.jsdelivr.net. Distribution
headers retain their copyright/license notices. Full license texts and source maps
are included. No runtime CDN requests are made.
Re-download and review these files when upgrading; do not edit minified sources.
